scope: Primary-source constraints for the private fresh-VMM continuation; implementation and KVM acceptance remain separate.

constraints: Snapshot state and memory do not include managed drive storage. Original relative resource paths must resolve inside the new jail.
A successful load with resume_vm=false leaves the target Paused. A failed load terminates its VMM rather than permitting uncertain reuse.
File-backed memory uses private mappings and stays immutable throughout the restored VM lifetime.
Existing vsock streams reset; the restored guest listener can accept a new authenticated connection.
Repeated continuation can duplicate application identifiers and tokens. VMGenID kernel reseeding does not rotate arbitrary userspace state.
sources.application: New unconfigured jailed VMM, independent mutable drive, protected lifetime memory copy, explicit paused observation, fresh control connection and guest authority transfer before thaw. Only one target after original source termination; retries never allocate another writer.

sources.observed: A dedicated load handler passes snapshot path, memory backend and explicit ResumeVM intent to LoadSnapshot and propagates failure.
sources.limit: The inspected SDK load wrapper does not establish GoldenHoop source termination, single-use claim, persistent manager recovery, quota or guest authority. Those require independent Rust implementation and actual acceptance.

observed: Current Kubernetes guide distinguishes rootfs-only recreation from opt-in QEMU guest-memory restoration and requires observed per-container image digests before rootfs success.
Snapshot provider selection is explicit; unsupported providers fail. Durable Pending/Committing/Succeed/Failed conditions remain separate from coarse sandbox phases.
Controller skips repeated pause for an already Paused generation and waits for stale snapshot deletion; old Pod termination may outlast coarse Paused state.
Firecracker integration documentation requires a probed reflink filesystem for its declared copy path and refuses unsupported setup.
sources.application: Keep snapshot kind/runtime selection explicit, preserve immutable operation identity and physical writer/root absence separately from lifecycle labels, and publish success from actual artifact/runtime observations. These constraints are implemented by the private Rust claim/loader and verified locally; actual continuation remains unaccepted.
sources.limits: The inspected rootfs/QEMU controller path does not establish Firecracker RAM restoration or GoldenHoop manager authority. GoldenHoop uses declared verified full copies; it does not inherit an XFS requirement or the old OSEP proposal as evidence of current behavior.

remaining: Full identical-source local checks and actual retained managed64 plus fresh-target continuation gate. Native supervisor/manager and public restore, templates and complete M4-M6 remain required.
